newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish cash squeeze continues, bond yields firm.
newsitem.headline: Turkish cash squeeze continues, bond yields firm.

text.p: 1000 GMT - Turkish money market opened 13 trillion lira short, average o/n money steady at 71.61 pct and average o/n repo at 77.86 pct, vs Thursday's 77.62. Bankers expect central bank funding on money and repo markets.

*Bond yields firmed 0.5-1 percentage points on tight money and central bank's move to raise its tom/next and tom/week offer rates by one point each to 71 and 72 pct respectively. The most active April 1, 1998 paper yielded 106.37 pct, vs 105.84.
*Lira at 150,000 to the dollar, weaker than Thursday's 149,400 close.
